prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1417; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was moving slowly through the turn when the impact came, pushing my vehicle forward and into the curb. My right knee hit the dashboard and I felt sharp pain almost immediately. I have been the named driver on this policy for the entire time the vehicle has been insured, and I have kept the same account of events since the accident. Later I remembered a few smaller details, such as the other car's position in the lane, but these additions did not change the core sequence of what happened. I sought medical attention for the knee injury the same day.
